title: CB8-B: pmxt v2 book states of the day's Up/Down tokens at t_end - {600, 300, 120, 60} s (hour 15Z; 14Z lookback only when needed; both clocks <= t) and Data API taker prints in [t_end - 15 min, t_end + 2 min]; HOLDOUT weeks to the sealed root; first stage: count-only pmxt coverage audit (hour 13Z of 20 seeded days; PASS iff >= 90% of (market, day) pairs present, else B not testable 'source unavailable'); pmxt ingress cap 90 GB
expected_value: recorded asks, depth and fee rates for B1 and B1-rep
data: r2v2.pmxt.dev hourly parquet (range reads by condition id)
outputs: docs/research_lab/seals/cb8_updown_holdout_SEAL.json (written by the job on the host; copy and commit it)
notes: CREATIVE_BATCH_8.md CB8-B. DRAFT. Commit with q0165. Days processed in a seeded order alternating SCREEN and HOLDOUT so the ingress cap truncates both evenly; missing/corrupt hours lose the day (counted, never replaced). Stores derived states only (tens of MB at most). No wallet stored. Final stage seals the HOLDOUT root (listing sha256) after seal-time drops by id and key against every seal copy committed by then (DROPPED_* blocks). Round 1 item 3: market-days without events in 14Z-15Z are labelled 'source unavailable' (never 'no trade'). Item 4: also stores the state at t + 10 s for the latency check. IMPLEMENTED 2026-10-17 (cb8_books.books_fetch). Refuses (exit 2) unless the frame run is updown_frame_complete and every frame file matches its manifest hash. Stage order: count-only coverage audit (hour 13Z of 20 seeded days; FAIL ends 'updown_books_source_unavailable', no checkpoint extracted), then per day (seeded order alternating SCREEN/HOLDOUT) states then prints, then finalize and the HOLDOUT seal. The ingress cap (90 GB decimal, audit included) is checked before each day; later days are recorded 'ingress_cap'. States are stored at t_end - {600,300,120,60} s and +10 s each (asks_top = best 10 ask levels for the latency check). Post-t_end prints go to *_guarded files. The lookback to 14Z is per token (no book event by t_end - 600 s).
